text_block_list.text:
Summer camp has ended. When I asked Super 
Creek how her summer went...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I had a wonderful, comfortable time~ 
Unlike last year, my heart felt completely 
clear and bright.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Having nothing to worry about is truly 
wonderful, isn't it? That way, we can 
build things up step by step.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Squinting against the blazing sunlight, 
working hard day by day alongside 
Trainer-san..."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Come to think of it~. Trainer, did you 
get a bit of a tan?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Hmm, you've somehow become even 
more mature, and don't really feel like a 
rookie Trainer anymore...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, the other Umamusume might 
not leave you alone either.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"You can't do that, okay? You shouldn't 
just wander off after someone just because 
they called out to you."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You're aiming for the Autumn GⅠ series 
with me, after all. Right, Trainer?

She really drove the point home. I'll 
brace myself and head into the Autumn 
Tenno Sho.
